notes.title: theBlu - Updated
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a newly updated and improved version of the award-winning VR experience, theBlu. This all new product features updated navigation, locomotion, and new options to enhance your enjoyment of the ocean, as well as three new DLC experiences including Hammerhead Cove, a brand new experience taking you to sunlit Caribbean waters where one creature reigns supreme. This is the first time Hammerhead Cove is being offered in theBlu. The original “Whale Encounter" with the Blue Whale is also now available as a free experience.

(For existing customers of theBlu product, you will find a new download link in your profile to the free app, plus the existing two episodes you already own)

Additional DLC content includes:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221281/theBlu__Reef_Migration/]Reef Migration[/url]: Witness the magnificence of an undersea migration on the edge of a coral reef.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221280/theBlu__Luminous_Abyss/]Luminous Abyss[/url]: Venture into the deepest region of the ocean to discover the iridescent abyss.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221282/theBlu__Hammerhead_Cove/]Hammerhead Cove[/url]: Sunlit Caribbean waters welcome you to a realm where one creature reigns supreme.
[/list]
We hope these new experiences provide even more wonder and majesty for you to explore in theBlu. Thank you for your support of our immersive VR series.

--------------

Additional Q&A - (12-31-2022)

It's hard to imagine that it has been 7 years since the original theBlu Season1 was released in 2016! For our customers past and present, we wanted to refresh the app to current standards, while at the same time offer the VR community a free-to-play version with the very first episode, our beloved "Whale Encounter" - thus, allowing more people to be introduced to VR for the first time. With this update, we also introduced a new DLC backbone & UI for new SP/MP-experiences that will help to set up for future mobileVR platforms (coming soon). 

theBlu at its core is a product about introducing VR experiences to the world and creating shared memories. We thank all our customers for their loyal support and appreciation for VR & our oceans.

---------------

Additional Q&A - (1-6-2023)

Users need to set SteamVR OpenXR as their default runtime. Oculus users should use either SteamVR OpenXR or Oculus OpenXR as their runtime.
